about: Manifest for the recommended stacks at /stacks/. Each entry names one Suede AI skill that covers the task (rendered above the article) and a Markdown body in directory/editorial/stacks/ that ranks third-party skills only. One disclosed section, "The Suede AI skill for this task", may name the stack's Suede AI skill; scripts/build-directory.mjs refuses Suede anywhere else in the body. The H1, byline, Reviewed date, JSON-LD and footer call to action come from this manifest and the directory's author record in editorial/pages.json. Keep em dashes out of every string.

hub.title: Agent Skill Stacks by Task: Jason Colapietro's Picks
hub.meta_description: Recommended agent skill stacks for twenty tasks, from presentations and email to security audits, with install commands and a Suede AI pick for each.
hub.intro: One job, one stack. Each article names the Suede AI skill that covers the task up front, then recommends the third-party skills to combine for it, with their scores, licenses and the exact install commands. Written by Jason Colapietro from the directory's published data.
hub.method: A stack is chosen from the directory's snapshot: skills that match the task, fit together, carry full pages and score well on the Suede Skill Check, with install counts from skills.sh where they exist. The Suede AI skill named above each article is kept out of the ranking and out of the article body. Stacks are reviewed after each directory refresh.
